content: <!-- Claude Code loads this file. AGENTS.md is the source of truth - edit that, not this. -->

1.title: Integrity
1.why: text a model reads that a reviewer cannot see - fix before anything else

2.title: Entry point
2.why: the shape every repository shares; the migration fixes most of these at once

3.title: Docs
3.why: one edit per file: frontmatter and routing

4.title: Budgets
4.why: sizes and counts; they shrink as content moves into routed docs

entry-point-lines.why: The entry point is loaded into every agent session, so each line costs context before any work starts.
entry-point-lines.fix: Move detail into a routed doc under docs/ and keep the entry point to pointers and rules.

entry-point-characters.why: A line budget can be beaten by a few very long lines; characters measure what the agent actually loads.
entry-point-characters.fix: Move long passages and tables into docs/ and route them with applies_to.

line-length.why: Lines wider than a screen are hard to review in a diff, and review is the only defence for instruction files.
line-length.fix: Wrap prose at the limit; tables and lines without whitespace have their own allowance.

doc-size.why: A routed doc is loaded whole whenever its globs match, so its size is paid on every matching change.
doc-size.fix: Split by topic into sibling docs with their own applies_to, or trim; raise the limit in .agent-docs.json only with a reason.

frontmatter-present.why: The description is what the routing table and an agent use to decide whether to open the doc at all.
frontmatter-present.fix: Add a frontmatter block with a one-line description under the length limit.

doc-reachable.why: A doc nobody routes to is never read, and a doc marked both routed and background has no clear role.
doc-reachable.fix: Give it applies_to globs, or mark it background: true if it is reference material only.

reference-resolves.why: A broken link sends an agent to a file or heading that does not exist, and it will guess instead of asking.
reference-resolves.fix: Fix the path or anchor; headings produce anchors the way GitHub does.

reference-to-shim.why: A reference to a CLAUDE.md that has become the shim still resolves, but an agent that opens it gets only '@AGENTS.md' - the pointer degrades without breaking.
reference-to-shim.fix: Point the reference at AGENTS.md instead; a sibling repository that has not migrated yet is left alone.

routing-current.why: The routing table is derived from the docs' frontmatter; a stale table routes an agent to the wrong place or nowhere.
routing-current.fix: Run Test-OctoAgentDocs -Fix to regenerate the block between the routing markers.

docs-count.why: A routing table longer than a screen stops being scannable, which defeats routing.
docs-count.fix: Merge docs that cover one topic, or mark reference material background.

shim-valid.why: Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md; once AGENTS.md is canonical the shim must import it and carry nothing else, or two files compete.
shim-valid.fix: Run Test-OctoAgentDocs -Fix; add -Force only after moving any real content out of CLAUDE.md.

required-sections.why: Every repository's entry point carries the same level-2 headings, so an agent finds build, commit and rules in the same place everywhere.
required-sections.fix: Add the missing '## ' heading and write its content; the checker never fills text in.

no-invisible-characters.why: Unicode tag, zero-width and bidirectional override characters carry text a reviewer cannot see but a model reads.
no-invisible-characters.fix: Delete the characters; if the file is generated, fix the generator.

link-hosts.why: An agent follows links, so an external host outside the allowlist is a way to feed it text nobody reviewed.
link-hosts.fix: Use an allowed host, or add the host to link-hosts.allow in .agent-docs.json with a reason.

migration-pending.why: AGENTS-MIGRATION.md is a working brief for the migration, not documentation; left behind, it misleads the next reader.
migration-pending.fix: Finish the steps it lists, then delete the file in the same commit.
